assumptions: ssimc (classical.rs:146-163,165-240): SSIM per RGB channel on 0-255, 11x11 Gaussian sigma=1.5 taps normalized, K1=.01 K2=.03 L=255, valid region (W-10)x(H-10), cs clipped >=0, mean over channels /3.
H-pass per output elem per ch (ring slot): 11 taps x [2 cvt + 2 load + m0 g*a (mul+add) + m1 (mul+add) + m2 g*a*a (2mul+add) + m3 (2mul+add) + m4 g*a*b (2mul+add)] = 11*(8mul+5add+2cvt+2load).
V-pass per output elem: 11 taps x 5 moments x (mul+add+load) = 55 mul+55 add+55 load; then per elem: vx,vy,cov (3mul+3add), lum (4mul+3add+1div), cs (2mul+3add+1div+1cmp), sum+= lum*cs (1mul+1add).
Per-channel mean = sum/(ow*oh) div; total/3: negligible final ops.
-f32 CLI variant = unrounded plane input (ssim_pyiqa.rs:6, rounded=false, factor=1); pipeline identical.

stages.name: h Gaussian moments (5 accumulators) into ring
v Gaussian moments + SSIM map + sum
